page.layout: One column of running text, centred in the printed page. No marginal notes, no footnotes, no catchword.

main_text.p: in proximum. Qua ratione dona non redundant in auctoris honorem, sed ignominiam. Nec beneficia redeunt à quo profecta, verum dirigunturin usum Diaboli, qui infensissi-mus largitoris benefici hostis. Ab illo talis se regi ac duci patitur, illius vestigiis insistit, ac presso pede ejusdem calcat semitas, qui duellantium gregi miscetur. Ille quippe primitus per serpentem hominem impulit ad tale factum, quod mors confestim est sub-secuta. Ut illum homicidium habeat auctorem, qui homicida ab initio, quiquè etiamnum talis, dum quasvis cuivis suggerit occasiones, quibus se læ-sum opinetur, neque aliter damnum resarciri posse credat, quam mortelaedentis. Cogitet amplius id in gloriâ Christiani redundare, si sequatur vestigia sui Salvatoris, eaque si fieri possit,

page.notes: The line "verum dirigunturin" has no printed space between "dirigunturin" and "usum", which is a printing error left as printed. "quiquè" is printed with a grave accent and is kept as printed. The word "hostis." at the end of the sixth-but-one line is slightly blurred and read as "hostis."; the reading is fairly certain. The last line is short, ending at the right margin with "possit," and the page continues there.
